mvp_baseline: Owner-approved local-first Windows sales core P0; P1 modules optional; execution authorization remains limited to D-21, D-22, D-30, D-31, D-32 and the D-33 presentation-only UI scope.
change_summary: Replaced the empty-body 404 that looked like a blank bright page with a themed "page not found" screen shown for every unknown URL (for example /cash, /sales, /purchases, /stock-movements or any random address), keeping the 404 status code and adding clear ways back to the home screen or the sales screen.
Kept missing file requests (/js/... and /css/...) as plain 404 responses so no HTML page is returned for a missing image, font or script.
Removed the dead stock-movements button from the products page; it was the only link that led to the removed screen and produced the blank page.

Recorded the new evidence and a framework note in docs/DECISIONS_AND_OPEN_GATES.md: on .NET 10 setting the 404 status inside the component prevents the page body from being written, so the status is set when the headers are sent.
Refreshed the pack manifestations with new fingerprints for v0.6.7.
review_findings: Build and tests after the change: dotnet build Wizz.sln -c Release = 0 errors (pre-existing StyleCop warnings only); Domain 24/24; Integration 262/262 (286 total).

HTTP check on an isolated instance with a temporary SQLite database (deleted afterwards): /cash, /sales, /purchases, /stock-movements?productId=x, /random-page and /some/deep/unknown return 404 with a 12,958-byte themed body; /login and /setup return 200; / and /products redirect to login (302); /js/missing.js and /css/missing.css stay 404 with no body; /js/quick-settings.js and /css/site.css return 200.

Browser check on the same instance: dark theme body rgb(31,31,31) with a rgb(37,37,38) card and rgb(204,204,204) text, light theme body rgb(241,245,249) with a white card and rgb(71,85,105) text, the page title is the Arabic not-found title, and there is no console error other than the 404 status itself.
Repeated the same 404, login, static-asset and home-redirect checks on the real instance at http://localhost:5183 after the change.

Correction: /Error is not missing; Components/Pages/Error.razor exists and answers 200, but it is still the default English template without layout or theme. The earlier note in this pack claimed the page did not exist because the first search only covered the Pages folder. Improving that page is not ordered yet.

Limitation: the 286 automated tests do not cover routing, the not-found screen or browser behaviour; the evidence above is manual and was not reproduced in CI because GitHub Actions remains unavailable for the account.
